versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md, including more detailed descriptions of API input parameters and options.
- Added enumeration options for template_id, asset_size, and mode input parameters.
- Clarified parameter tables and added more input option details for improved usability.

Stuffed-toy-generator 1.0.0 initial release:

- Launch of an AI-powered stuffed toy and 3D model generator using state-of-the-art 3D APIs via the OneKey Agent Gateway.
- Supports creation of toy design drafts, multi-view reference sheets, and 3D printable models from text and image prompts.
- Provides templates for figurines, stuffed toys, 3D printing, game assets, and architectural toys.
- Offers REST API endpoints for design draft generation, 3D model task creation, and task status polling.
- Detailed workflow and integration instructions included for seamless use with Craftsman Agent services.
